The issue reports that reminder emails show the live URL as plain text and direct users to the authenticated calendar. It requests a clickable `Watch live broadcast` button when `live_broadcast_url` exists, retention of `Open calendar` as a secondary action, omission of the broadcast action and empty row when the URL is absent, and coverage for the 3-day, 1-day, and 15-minute reminders.

## Impact And Limits

- The change is limited to reminder notification construction, the shared notification email template, and automated coverage.
- Event title, times, location, description, timezone presentation, reminder offsets, recipient rules, delivery tracking, and the secondary calendar action remain unchanged.
- No schema, route, authorization, external provider, infrastructure, licence-cost, or schedule-baseline change is approved.
- The broadcast button bypasses Lead Hub login. Authentication or access requirements imposed by the external broadcast provider remain outside this change.
- Staging mail, live delivery, queue, scheduler, monitoring, participant use, and launch acceptance remain separate evidence gates under the existing reminder controls.

## Duplicate And Relationship Review

- CHG-27 (Add event-level email reminders to Lead Hub calendar events), ACT-45 (Implement and verify calendar event email reminders), and R-15 (Calendar reminder delivery may be late, duplicated, or unavailable) cover reminder scheduling and delivery. They do not provide the direct broadcast-link presentation requested by issue #39.
- Existing RQ-14 (The application should provide a calendar with scheduled events and configurable email reminders), RQ-08 (The application must work on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices), and LL-31 (Implement and verify event-level email reminders) remain the applicable requirements and learning record.
- DEP-11 (Production email transport, queue worker, and scheduler for calendar reminders) remains a separate operational dependency. This change does not claim that external broadcast access or email delivery is available.
